description: Stop networking and start connecting! Be the magnet, not the megaphone #networkwithintention #buildyourcircle #careeradvice #lifebydesign #careershift #IntentionalLiving #leadershipdevelopment
transcript: How I've built a strong network is I lead with value within everything that I do when I'm in rooms I'm asking questions and I'm showing genuine interests because that gives me the opportunity to allow others to vet me while I'm vetting them as well because not everybody is going to be for me and I will not be for everyone So I've learned to maintain relationships by not being transactional I really lead with the service how I can be of assistance to you in the work that you're doing as well as showing up in support of others if there's a networking event if there's opportunities or friends asking hey, can I pick your brain on this event or that I Use my skills to show up for them and be more of an asset and turn Others are there to support you in your endeavors
